title: Appending to a paired word
statement: For all Boolean words $a,b,c$, appending $c$ to the encoding of the pair $(a,b)$ gives the encoding of $(a,b	ext{ followed by }c)$; that is, $\langle a,b\rangle c=\langle a,bc\rangle$.
replaced: For all words $a$, $b$, and $c$, the self-delimiting encoding of $a$ with payload $b$, followed by $c$, equals the encoding of $a$ with payload $b$ followed by $c$; the boundary of the first field is preserved.
